## Kernel TCP/IP ## TSO and GRO
MechanismDescription
TSO (Tx)TCP Segmentation Offload. Offloads the segmentation of “big” packets (up to 64KB) into frames to the NIC.
GRO (Rx)Generic Receive Offload. Aggregates MTU-sized frames into a “big” packet (up to 64KB) before passing them to the TCP/IP layer.
GSO provides software segmentation. TSO delegates it to the NIC. GRO combines received segments before TCP processing. Larger processing units amortize protocol and buffer-management work. Wire packets still obey the MTU. Receive aggregation happens at the host.
